decisions.reason: A coolant pressure booster system extends the firm's core coolant management offer in a growing industry, and a large firm has the slack to carry it while results mature.
The cleaning centrifuge builds on established filtration competence and fits sustainability aspirations, so there is no evident shortfall that would prompt search for other uses of the resources.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost complementary item that supports system sales, so dropping them gains little and keeping them is a satisficing choice.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's core conveyor business and likely meets aspiration levels drawn from past conveyor performance.
The magnetic belt conveyor rounds out the chip conveyor portfolio for metalworking customers, and organisational slack allows the firm to keep it.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a standard core product line with stable demand, giving no trigger for problemistic search.
